title.rendered: DIGITAL CENSUS

content.rendered:
ROAD MAP TO DIGITAL CENSUS

Background and Justification for 7th Population and Housing Census -2022

As per decision of Council of Common Interest (CCI) to conduct Population and Housing Census-2017 started from 15th March to 24th May, 2017.

  1. Provisional results were notified in November 2017, however due to opposing of some stakeholder’s final results were not approved. Keeping in view the sensitivity of the Census results the Cabinet decided to constitute a Ministers Committee on 11.02.2020 for detailed deliberations and for recommendations regarding finalization of results of Census-2017.
  2. The Committee conducted six meetings and after extensive discussions & considerations submitted its report with recommendations for approval of results of Census-2017 in a larger national interest and to the conduct next census earlier possible by adopting modern technologies.

title.rendered: QUESTIONNAIRE DESIGN & FINALIZATION

content.rendered:
Finalization of Census Questionnaires

In the light of the decisions of 7th Meetings of the Committee constituted for recommendation and adoption of best practices for upcoming Census held on 15th July 2021, that a Committee may be constituted for finalization of Census Questionnaire.

Members of the Questionnaire committee are as follows:-

S.# Name & Designation Status
1 Dr. G.M.Arif, Demographer Chairman
2 Dr. Zeba A. Sathar, Demographer Member
3 Dr. Nousheen  Mehmood, Demographer Member
4 Dr. Tauseef Ahmed, Demographer Member
5 Muhammad Saeed Ex Census Commissioner, PBS Member
6 Professor Dr. Muhammad Iqbal , University of Peshawar Member
7 Dr. Durr e Nayab, Joint Director PIDE Member
8 Mr. Muhammad Sarwar Gondal (Consultant),PBS Islamabad Member
9 Mr Ayazuddin, Member (C&S) PBS Islamabad Member
10 Mr.Muhammad Bashir Janjua, JCC (Admin), PBS Islamabad Member
11 Ms Rabia Awan , Director (CP&C),PBS,  Islamabad Member/ 

Secretary
12 Mr.. Muhammad Saeed, ACC, (DP), PBS, Islamabad Member

 

Detailed deliberations were made on each and every question of “Individual Questionnaire” and “Housing Questionnaire” and resultantly. Both questionnaires have been finalized unanimously by all the esteemed members of the committee after comprehensive study of Census Questionnaire used in the region/globe and also analyzing in detail the previous Census Questionnaires used in Pakistan.

Keeping in view the challenging timelines for conduct of first ever Digital Census Questionnaire has been finalized and approved by the Technical Committee.

title.rendered: CONSULTATIVE MEETINGS WITH PROVINCES

content.rendered:
CONSULTATIVE MEETINGS WITH PROVINCE/REGIONS 7th POPULATION & HOUSING CENSUS
The Population & Housing Census is crucial national exercise linked with provision of data for key policy making matters regarding development programs, political representation & resource allocation which have far reaching impacts. Keeping in view the importance & sensitivity of matter and decision of CCI “to conduct next census as early possible by using modern technologies”, The Committee after series of meeting devised recommendations and strongly proposed that in order to bring transparency, credibility and ownership of whole census processes, Provinces must be involved from start to end i.e. from planning to compilation of census results. The 7th Population & Housing Census online orientation meeting with Chief Secretaries of all Provinces/regions was held on 13.08.2021 under the Chairmanship of Secretary, M/o PD&SI. It was decided that physical meetings of PBS teams will be held with provincial governments/ AJ&K & GB for detailed deliberation and feedback on recommendations before its finalization for approval from the appropriate forum.  In pursuance of the decisions of the above meeting, following meeting with provinces have been conducted so far: These meetings are a remarkable step towards confidence building of stake holder/(provinces) which will be helpful in gaining the support of provinces during census process and acceptability of census results.

SR. NO NAME OF PROVINCE DATE DETAILS
1. Punjab 6th September, 2021 Minutes / Gallery
2. Sindh 8th September, 2021 Minutes / Gallery
3. Balochistan 10th September, 2021 Record Note / Gallery
4. KPK 13th September, 2021 Record Note / Gallery
5. Gilgit Baltistan 16th September, 2021  Record Note / Gallery

The PBS team presented the detail regarding the broader recommendation of the Census Advisory Committee with clear road map and timelines to complete the process. It was informed that as per directions of the CCI, the upcoming Census will be the first ever   “Digital Census” of Pakistan, the detail methodology and use of modern technology was explained and highlighted the role of provinces in the field of data collection & monitoring process and informed all the feedback regarding process and the tools will be incorporated in the recommendation after completion of all consultations before final approval.

title.rendered: SENSITIZATION WORKSHOPS

content.rendered:
SENSITIZATION WORKSHOPS ON 7 TH POPULATION & HOUSING CENSUS 2022

The Council of Common Interest (CCI) in the 45 th meeting held on 12-04-2021 had decided that “the process of next census should start as early as possible according to international best practices by using latest technology”. In pursuance of the decision of the meeting made by  Council of Common Interest (CCI) meeting, PBS is strictly following the timelines of the activities to accomplish the gigantic task within stipulated timelines to provide the data to Government of Pakistan in December 2022. Keeping in view the challenging timelines of activities of the first –ever digital census, the worthy Minister for PD&SI during a review committee meeting held on 26 th November,2021, emphasized on the prior sensitization of forthcoming Population and housing census-2022,First Ever Digital , to improve the role of Stakeholders as well as public through the conduct of workshops/seminars throughout the country. In this regard PBS decided to conduct Sensitization Workshops at Provincial level to bring awareness about the census process among the masses and to avoid the trust deficit by engaged Academia/Universities, Researchers, Demographers, Data users, NGOS and other Stakeholders.

1st Sensitization Workshop (Dec 24, 2021 at Allama Iqbal Open University Islamabad)

title.rendered: Release of National and Provincial Census Reports of Population and Housing Census 2023

content.rendered:
The Pakistan Bureau of Statistics (PBS) has released the detailed National & Provincial census Reports of the 7th Population and Housing Census 2023 for Pakistan, Punjab, Sindh, Khyber Pakhtunkhwa, Balochistan, and Islamabad Capital Territory. These comprehensive reports present detailed district-wise indicators covering key demographic and housing characteristics of each province. To enhance data visualization and facilitate user understanding, indicators have also been illustrated through infographics and heat maps, enabling readers to interpret the results more effectively and gain deeper insights into regional patterns and trends. All detail tables in PDF and Excel format already available At PBS website.

title.rendered: Advance Release Calendar of National Accounts for FY 2025–26

content.rendered:
National Accounts Committee (NAC) Meeting

📅 30th December 2025

The National Accounts Committee (NAC) approved Q1 growth for FY 2025–26 and updated annual estimates for FY 2024–25.

📊 Key Highlights

  • Economy posted a growth of 3.71% during FY2025–26 Q1 due to positive growth in Agriculture (2.89%), Industry (9.38%), and Services (2.35%).
  • Annual updated GDP growth rate for FY2024–25 stands at 3.09% as compared to 3.04% approved at the 114th NAC meeting.

📁 Related Documents


📄 Press Release (115th NAC Meeting)


📊 QNA Release FY2025‑26 Q1 (Pager)


📈 National Accounts Tables 2024‑25 (R1 – Excel)

title.rendered: Quantum Index of Large Scale Manufacturing Industries (QIM) for Nomember 2025

content.rendered:
QIM – Summary & Tables (November 2025)The provisional quantum indices of Large Scale Manufacturing Industries (LSMI) for November 2025 (Base Year 2015-16) have been developed on the basis of latest data supplied by the source agencies. The indices for November 2025 and July–November 2025-26 along with growth are as follows:

  • QIM estimated for November 2025 is 118.28.
  • The LSMI output increased by 10.37% for November 2025 when compared with November 2024 and 0.16% when compared with October 2025.
  • QIM estimated for July–November 2025-26 is 115.72.
  • Overall Large Scale Manufacturing Sector has shown a growth of 6.01% during July–November 2025-26 when compared with the same period of last year.

title.rendered: Quantum Index of Large Scale Manufacturing Industries (QIM) for December 2025

content.rendered:
The provisional quantum indices of Large Scale Manufacturing Industries (LSMI) for December, 2025 with base year 2015-16 have been developed on the basis of latest data supplied by the source agencies. The indices for December, 2025 and July- December 2025-26 along with growth are as follows: –

  • QIM estimated for July- December, 2025-26 is 117.70.
  • Overall Large Scale Manufacturing Sector has shown a growth of 4.82% during July- December 2025-26 when compared with the same period of last year.
  • QIM estimated for December, 2025 is 128.51.
  • The LSMI output increased by 0.44% for December, 2025 when compared with December, 2024 and 9.26% when compared with November, 2025.

title.rendered: Summary of Provisional Quantum Index Numbers of Large Scale Manufacturing Industries (QIM) for January 2026

content.rendered:
The provisional quantum indices of Large Scale Manufacturing Industries (LSMI) for
January 2026 with base year 2015–16 have been developed on the
basis of the latest data supplied by the source agencies. The indices for
January 2026 and July–January 2025–26 along with growth are as follows:

  • QIM estimated for July- January, 2025-26 is 121.46.
  • Overall Large Scale Manufacturing Sector has shown a growth of 5.75% during July- January 2025-26 when compared with the same period of last year.
  • QIM estimated for January, 2026 is 144.00.
  • The LSMI output increased by 10.54% for January, 2026 when compared with January, 2025 and 12.08% when compared December, 2025.

title.rendered: National Accounts Committee (NAC) Meeting

content.rendered:
National Accounts Committee (NAC) Meeting

📅 2nd April 2026


The National Accounts Committee (NAC) approved provisional quarterly growth for Q2 and revised growth figures for FY 2025-26 Q1, along with updated annual growth rates for FY 2023-24 and FY 2024-25.

📊 Key Highlights

  • Led by the Industry (7.40%) and supported by positive contributions from Agriculture (1.76%) and Services (3.69%), the economy grew by 3.89% during FY2025–26 Q2.
  • Despite improvement in Services from 2.35% to 2.44%, the overall updated growth for FY2025–26 Q1 is 3.63%, down from 3.71% approved in the previous NAC meeting, due to downward revisions in Agriculture from 2.89% to 2.72% and Industry from 9.38% to 8.86%.
  • The updated annual GDP growth rates for FY2023–24 and FY2024–25 are 2.62% and 3.06%, respectively, compared to the previously estimated 2.63% and 3.09%.

title.rendered: Quantum Index of Large Scale Manufacturing Industries (QIM) for Feb 2026

content.rendered:
The provisional quantum indices of Large Scale Manufacturing Industries (LSMI) for February, 2026 with base year 2015-16 has been developed on the basis of latest data supplied by the source agencies. The indices for February, 2026 and July-February 2025-26 along with growth are as follows: –

    • QIM estimated for July- February, 2025-26 is 122.77.
    • Overall Large Scale Manufacturing Sector has indicated a growth of 5.89% during July- February 2025-26 when compared with the same period of the last year.
    • QIM estimated for February, 2026 is 131.50.
    • The LSMI output increased by 6.45% for February, 2026 when compared with February, 2025 and decreased by -8.97% when compared January, 2026.

Industry Section

title.rendered: Summary of Provisional Quantum Index Numbers of Large Scale Manufacturing Industries (QIM) for March 2026

content.rendered:
The provisional quantum indices of Large Scale Manufacturing Industries (LSMI) for March, 2026 with base year 2015-16 has been developed on the basis of latest data supplied by the source agencies. The indices for March, 2026 and July-March 2025-26 along with growth are as follows: –

  • QIM estimated for July- March, 2025-26 is 123.03.
  • Overall Large Scale Manufacturing Sector has indicated a growth of 6.48% during July- March 2025-26 when compared with the same period of the last year.
  • QIM estimated for March, 2026 is 124.89.
  • The LSMI output increased by 11.09% for March, 2026 when compared with March, 2025 and decreased by -5.19% when compared with February, 2026.

title.rendered: Summary of Provisional Quantum Index Numbers of Large Scale Manufacturing Industries (QIM) for April 2026

content.rendered:
The provisional quantum indices of Large Scale Manufacturing Industries (LSMI) for April, 2026 with base year 2015-16 has been developed on the basis of latest data supplied by the source agencies. The indices for April, 2026 and July-April 2025-26 along with growth are as follows: –

  • QIM estimated for July- April, 2025-26 is 122.19.
  • Overall Large Scale Manufacturing Sector has indicated a growth of 6.44% during July- April 2025-26 when compared with the same period of the last year.
  • QIM estimated for April, 2026 is 114.56.
  • The LSMI output increased by 6.06% for April, 2026 when compared with April, 2025 and decreased by 8.32% when compared with March, 2026.

title.rendered: Summary of Provisional Quantum Index Numbers of Large Scale Manufacturing Industries (QIM) for May 2026

content.rendered:
The provisional quantum indices of Large Scale Manufacturing Industries (LSMI) for May, 2026 with base year 2015-16 has been developed on the basis of latest data supplied by the source agencies. The indices for May, 2026 and July-May2025-26 along with growth are as follows:

  • QIM estimated for July-May, 2025-26 is 121.65.
  • Overall Large Scale Manufacturing Sector has indicated a growth of 5.77% during July-May 2025-26 when compared with the same period of the last year.
  • QIM estimated for May, 2026 is 116.10.
  • The LSMI output decreased by 0.98% for May, 2026 when compared with May, 2025 and increased by 1.21% when compared with April, 2026.
